sources.title: Snapkitty/SNAPKITTYWEST-public-snapshot · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: SnapKitty Sovereign OS — a financial operating system where the AI agents think out loud. 11 agents. Each one named, opinionated, with a domain and a peer network. Every decision goes through a three-pillar preflight, runs through a local LLM (Ollama), and gets sealed with SHA-256. The War Room UI shows every step as it happens — in real time.
